title: Code and data: Trust Mechanisms for Offline Generative AI at the Edge
description: Code, per-query outputs, and analysis scripts for the paper "Trust Mechanisms for Offline Generative AI at the Edge: A Connectivity-Regime Framework and an Empirical Study on a Raspberry Pi 5". Includes the Raspberry Pi 5 experiment scripts (network-isolated retrieval-augmented generation with Qwen2.5 models, signed knowledge packs, update-security tests, signed poisoning, entailment verification), all released per-query results, and a one-command script that regenerates every table value. Original code under the MIT licence; derived SQuAD 2.0 data under CC BY-SA 4.0.
